Subject: A time you were waiting for is free

A time you were waiting for at Synthetic clinic has become free.
Date and time: Monday 7 January 2030, 10:00 (Europe/Sarajevo)

It is held for you until 09:10 (Europe/Sarajevo). After that it is offered to the next patient. Accepting it in the app books the appointment.

To accept or decline it, open the Salus app:
https://patient.example.test/waitlist
